ItemMetadata.name: The Gnashing Sash
explicit_mods: Lose (5-5)% of maximum Life per second
Life Recovery from Flasks can Overflow Maximum Life
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"Ghorr knows only hunger, only ravenous feasting.
It will consume all that lives, and more!"
- Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page fourteen

ItemMetadata.name: Mageblood
explicit_mods: All Mage's Legacies have (25-50)% increased effect per duplicate Mage's Legacy you have
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Rivers of power coursed through their veins.
Now, that power is yours, for good or ill.

ItemMetadata.name: Headhunter
explicit_mods: When you kill a Rare monster, you gain its Modifiers for 60 seconds
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"A man's soul rules from a cavern of bone, learns and
judges through flesh-born windows. The heart is meat.
The head is where the Man is."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom

ItemMetadata.name: Eshtera's Path
explicit_mods: You can only Socket Sapphire Jewels in this item
+(5-10)% to Fire and Cold Resistances per Equipped Item with a Lightning Resistance Modifier
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
During the Winter of the World, her akhara began
shepherding jingakh across the harsh Vastiri. Sekhema
Eshtera planted the seeds of Maraketh diplomacy.

ItemMetadata.name: Kalandra's Touch
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Power is a matter of perspective.

ItemMetadata.name: Bursting Decay
explicit_mods: Lose (5-5)% of maximum Life per second
Attacks have added Physical damage equal to (3-3)% of maximum Life
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"All Beidat desires is a foothold, a grip on your flesh,
on the world... he will offer you anything to get it..."
- Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page thirty

ItemMetadata.name: The Taming
explicit_mods: (10-20)% increased Damage for each type of Elemental Ailment on Enemy
Wind Skills which can be boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces can be boosted by multiple Elemental Ground Surfaces

Wind Skills which can be boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces count
as being boosted by Ignited, Shocked, and Chilled Ground
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"Moon after moon did Berek make fools
Of the great and Untamed Three
Until malice for a Brother
Slew the hatred of the Other
And Berek did hunt
Alone and free."
- Berek and the Untamed

ItemMetadata.name: Safrin's Resolve
explicit_mods: You can only Socket Ruby Jewels in this item
+(5-10)% to Cold and Lightning Resistances per Equipped Item with a Fire Resistance Modifier
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The Vaal protected those who integrated into their 
culture. Many neighbours became one. Sekhema Safrin 
vowed the Maraketh identity would remain resolute.

ItemMetadata.name: Dream Fragments
explicit_mods: You cannot be Chilled or Frozen
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Doryani stumbled into a realm of madness
And awoke its Master.

ItemMetadata.name: Zaida's Longevity
explicit_mods: You can only Socket Emerald Jewels in this item
+(5-10)% to Fire and Lightning Resistances per Equipped Item with a Cold Resistance Modifier
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The relative peace under the fledgling Empire saw
the first Sekhema to choose, in her resplendent age and
wisdom, to step down. The role of Zaitema was born.

ItemMetadata.name: Snakepit
explicit_mods: Left ring slot: Projectiles from Spells cannot Chain
Left ring slot: Projectiles from Spells Fork
Right ring slot: Projectiles from Spells Chain +1 times
Right ring slot: Projectiles from Spells cannot Fork
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: They wrap around you until your blood turns as cold as theirs.

uniques.Text: Choir of the Storm Jade Amulet
uniques.Name: Choir of the Storm

ItemMetadata.name: Choir of the Storm
explicit_mods: Critical Hits Ignore Enemy Monster Lightning Resistance
Trigger Lightning Bolt Skill on Critical Hit
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
But the fool did not bow.
The fool stood and questioned.
And the fool was unwritten.

ItemMetadata.name: Immaculate Adherence
explicit_mods: (100-100)% of Damage is taken from Mana before Life
Convert 100% of maximum Energy Shield to maximum Divinity

ItemMetadata.flavor_text: To stray is to condemn this world to sin.

ItemMetadata.name: Yoke of Suffering
explicit_mods:
Enemies take (15-20)% increased Damage for each Elemental Ailment type among
your Ailments on them
(-40--30)% reduced Duration of Ignite, Shock and Chill on Enemies
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Let the unrepentant be dragged ever downwards by the weight of their sins.

ItemMetadata.name: Astramentis
explicit_mods: (-4--4) Physical Damage taken from Attack Hits
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Mindless rage will shake the world,
Cunning lies will bend it.
Reckless haste will break the world,
And into darkness send it.

ItemMetadata.name: Andvarius
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Danger is the price of wealth.

ItemMetadata.name: Ventor's Gamble
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
In a blaze of glory,
An anomaly defying all odds
The "unkillable" beast met the divine
And Ventor met his latest trophy.

ItemMetadata.name: Original Sin
explicit_mods: (100-100)% of Elemental Damage Converted to Chaos Damage
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Innocence rose to godhood not on inspired faith,
but on the vilification and hatred of another.

ItemMetadata.name: Defiance of Destiny
explicit_mods: Recover (20-30)% of Missing Life before being Hit by an Enemy
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The respect of Karui warriors is hard to earn,
but lasts a lifetime... and beyond.

ItemMetadata.name: Shavronne's Satchel
explicit_mods: Life Recovery from Flasks also applies to Energy Shield
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Bring mystery to life. Again and again.

ItemMetadata.name: Serpent's Egg
explicit_mods: Gain an additional Charge when you gain a Charge
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
When Kabala the Serpent Queen was banished from Keth,
the Sekhemas took a single hostage as punishment.

ItemMetadata.name: Ingenuity
explicit_mods: (20-30)% increased bonuses gained from left Equipped Ring
(20-30)% increased bonuses gained from right Equipped Ring
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Experiments with geomancy taught
the Maji more than they ever expected.

ItemMetadata.name: Thief's Torment
explicit_mods: Gain (25-25) Life per Enemy Hit with Attacks
Gain (15-15) Mana per Enemy Hit with Attacks
(-50--50)% reduced Duration of Curses on you
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The ring I stole,
My finger they took,
A shrouded mind,
Cut their curses short,
As I drained their spirit
And stole their soul.
A blessing is often a curse.

ItemMetadata.name: The Pandemonius
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
A single moment sets in motion an eternal fall,
beneath which all are buried.

ItemMetadata.name: Meginord's Girdle
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Kaom's strength was rivaled only by
the great Meginord of the north.

ItemMetadata.name: Perandus Seal
explicit_mods: (10-15)% increased Quantity of Gold Dropped by Slain Enemies
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: A pact with Prospero always comes at a price.

ItemMetadata.name: Doedre's Damning
explicit_mods: You can apply an additional Curse
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Where her mouth should have been there was only a whirling, black void.

ItemMetadata.name: Levinstone
explicit_mods: +1 to Level of all Lightning Skills
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Highgate held other secrets.

ItemMetadata.name: Death Rush
explicit_mods: Leech (5-5)% of Physical Attack Damage as Life
You gain Onslaught for (4-4) seconds on Kill
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: To truly appreciate life you must be there when it ends

ItemMetadata.name: Carnage Heart
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Forged from the blood of countless wars, 
its thirst has only begun.

ItemMetadata.name: Surefooted Sigil
explicit_mods: (50-50)% increased Evasion Rating if you've Dodge Rolled Recently
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Natural grace is born, not earned.

ItemMetadata.name: Strugglescream
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
There is no light at the end of this inner strife,
but the shadows eventually become home.

ItemMetadata.name: Waistgate
explicit_mods: Life and Mana Flasks can be equipped in either slot
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Clever artifice is not always complex.

ItemMetadata.name: Blackheart

explicit_mods: Adds (8-10) to 10 Chaos Damage to Attacks
(25-25)% chance to Intimidate Enemies for 4 seconds on Hit
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Fear is highly infectious.

ItemMetadata.name: Seed of Cataclysm
explicit_mods: (30-50)% increased Critical Hit Chance for Spells
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: The dawn of a new era is set into motion

ItemMetadata.name: Veilpiercer
explicit_mods: Curses you inflict can affect Hexproof Enemies
Curses you inflict spread to enemies within 3 metres when Cursed enemy dies
Gain 1 Dark Whisper every second there is a Cursed Enemy in your Presence
(20-40)% increased Damage with Hits against targets in your Presence
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The tribe revelled wildly, unaware that each fruit 
they ate further bound their continuity to the fog's. 
In time, the merest touch could break their reality.

ItemMetadata.name: Idol of Uldurn
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Worship of house gods was tolerated
in Oriath, so long as it remained private.

ItemMetadata.name: Igniferis
explicit_mods: Life Recovery from Regeneration is not applied
Every (0.2-0.2) seconds, Recover 1 Life for every 0.2 Life Recovery per second from Regeneration
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
A hearth unyielding, ever warm,
A light unbroken, endlessly reborn.

ItemMetadata.name: Eye of Chayula
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Never blinking, always watching.

ItemMetadata.name: The Everlasting Gaze
explicit_mods: Gain (4-6)% of maximum Mana as Extra maximum Energy Shield
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
What they saw was what they believed, and
they believed Lunaris had not abandoned them.

ItemMetadata.name: Ungil's Harmony
explicit_mods: Your Critical Hits do not deal extra Damage
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Gentle anger, raging calm.

ItemMetadata.name: Revered Resin
explicit_mods: Life Flasks gain (0.17-0.25).18 charges per Second
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: The sacred sap flows slowly, but surely.

ItemMetadata.name: Xoph's Blood
explicit_mods: Enemies in your Presence have (-25--25)% to Fire Resistance
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
We are his blood.
Through us he carries his burning message.

ItemMetadata.name: Ligurium Talisman
explicit_mods: Life Regeneration is applied to Energy Shield instead
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Healing the soul requires sacrifice.

ItemMetadata.name: Stone of Lazhwar
explicit_mods: +(15-25)% to Block Chance while holding a Focus
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
You are slow, foolish and ignorant.
I am not.

ItemMetadata.name: Rondel of Fragility
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Fanatics are the most dangerous enemy,
for they care not for their own survival.

ItemMetadata.name: The Anvil
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Forge your Perseverance on the Anvil of Faith.

ItemMetadata.name: Fixation of Yix
explicit_mods: Allies in your Presence have (30-50)% increased Critical Hit Chance
Allies in your Presence have (30-50)% increased Critical Damage Bonus
Allies in your Presence have (10-20)% increased Attack Speed
Allies in your Presence have (10-20)% increased Cast Speed
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
He knew not why he was changing, only
that he wanted to hold his family close...

ItemMetadata.name: Hinekora's Sight
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Remember the past, anticipate the future.

ItemMetadata.name: Beacon of Azis
explicit_mods: Critical Hits ignore Enemy Monster Elemental Resistances
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The homeguard signalled for aid against a surprise attack,
but it was not their dekharas that responded.
It was Solerai herself.

ItemMetadata.name: Fireflower
explicit_mods: Take (100-100) Fire Damage when you Ignite an Enemy
+(1-4) to Level of all Fire Skills
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Tale-women in training drink of a painful desert fruit.
Fire, they learn, springs from agony.

ItemMetadata.name: Midnight Braid
explicit_mods: (50-50)% of Damage taken Recouped as Mana
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Adversity is the soil in
which persistence grows.

uniques.Text: Cat O' Nine Tails Utility Belt
uniques.Name: Cat O' Nine Tails

explicit_mods: Regenerate (5-5)% of maximum Life per second if you have been Hit Recently
Life Recovery other than Flasks cannot Recover Life to above Low Life
Gain Physical Thorns damage equal to (12-12)% - 12% of maximum Life
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
A Templar thinks he's righteous for flogging
himself once for every ten lashings he gives.

ItemMetadata.name: Darkness Enthroned
explicit_mods: This item gains bonuses from Socketed Items as though it was Gloves
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Kulemak sat triumphant, raising the crown.
Darkness coiled the world in eternal night.
Victory, a mere moment, came crashing down.
No conqueror, no conquered, only searing Light.

ItemMetadata.name: Keelhaul
explicit_mods: Life Flasks gain (0.25-0.25).25 charges per Second
Mana Flasks gain (0.25-0.25).25 charges per Second
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Below all living things,
there exists a flow...

ItemMetadata.name: Umbilicus Immortalis
explicit_mods: Your Life Flask also applies to your Minions
Minions cannot Die while affected by a Life Flask
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"The power of rebirth rivals that of immortality."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 3

ItemMetadata.name: Birthright Buckle
explicit_mods: Life Flasks used while on Low Life apply Recovery Instantly
Mana Flasks used while on Low Mana apply Recovery Instantly
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Some families have peculiar gifts...

ItemMetadata.name: Byrnabas
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: The Brinerot sail without fear of storms.

ItemMetadata.name: Soul Tether
explicit_mods: You lose (5-5)% of maximum Energy Shield per second
Excess Life Recovery from Leech is applied to Energy Shield
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Vaal bloodpriests were among the earliest intellectuals on record.
It was they who found that a newly freed soul would
desperately cling to any other source of life.

ItemMetadata.name: Goregirdle
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Bleeding just means you're still alive.

ItemMetadata.name: Ryslatha's Coil
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: All creatures have the potential for greatness or unequivocal failure.

ItemMetadata.name: Coward's Legacy
explicit_mods: (30-40)% increased Life and Mana Recovery from Flasks
You are considered on Low Life while at (75-75)% of maximum Life or below instead
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Death is your most important duty.
Face it, or curse your bloodline for all eternity.

ItemMetadata.name: Bijouborne
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Trifle not with the trinket mage.

ItemMetadata.name: Zerphi's Genesis
explicit_mods: Corrupted Blood cannot be inflicted on you
(50-50)% of charges used by Charms granted to your Life Flasks
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: The most horrifying ideas often begin with a simple innovation.

ItemMetadata.name: Icefang Orbit
implicit_mods: Adds (4-4) to 4 Physical Damage to Attacks
explicit_mods: Adds (9-13) to 13 Physical Damage to Attacks
All Damage taken from Hits while Poisoned Contributes to Magnitude of Chill on you
All Damage from Hits against Poisoned targets Contributes to Chill Magnitude
(15-25)% increased Magnitude of Poison you inflict
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Those members of the Brotherhood who employ the venom of 
Trarthan ice snakes must take great care with the volatile substance.

ItemMetadata.name: Venopuncture

explicit_mods: Adds (9-13) to 12 Physical Damage to Attacks

All Damage from Hits against Bleeding targets Contributes to Chill Magnitude
(10-20)% chance to inflict Bleeding on Hit
(15-25)% increased Magnitude of Bleeding you inflict
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
There is a way to survive the bite of an ice snake,
but few have the resolve to attempt it.

ItemMetadata.name: Prized Pain

Deal your Thorns Damage to Enemies you Stun with Melee Attacks
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Agony brings clarity to those of pure mind.

ItemMetadata.name: Glowswarm
explicit_mods: Mana Flasks gain (0.17-0.25).18 charges per Second
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
As their eyes adjusted, they became aware of a strange
blue light. Countless glowing worms crawled above,
blissfully unaware of their flight from the sirens.

ItemMetadata.name: Blistering Bond
explicit_mods: You take Fire Damage instead of Physical Damage from Bleeding
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"The Brotherhood of Silence does not set out to torture our targets.
Excruciating pain is simply a byproduct of certain... necessary methods."

ItemMetadata.name: Cracklecreep
explicit_mods: Ignites you inflict spread to other Enemies that stay within 1.5 metres for 1 second
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Fear the fire that spreads like a plague.

ItemMetadata.name: Polcirkeln
explicit_mods: Enemies Chilled by your Hits can be Shattered as though Frozen
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
I rule the north
A legacy earned
Time and time again
Sing Meginord's song!

ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Forged by the last remaining brother
to return all that was once given.

explicit_mods: (100-100)% of Lightning Damage Converted to Cold Damage
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Forged by three brothers
so that they may recognize each other
across any distance of time or travel.

ItemMetadata.name: The Burrower
explicit_mods: Lightning Damage of Enemies Hitting you is Unlucky
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
It coils deeper and deeper
It slithers between thoughts
It lies beneath the valley
It lies in our minds

ItemMetadata.name: Blackflame

ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Beyond the veil of death, there burns a fire
by whose light night is borne.

ItemMetadata.name: Ming's Heart
explicit_mods: Gain (30-40)% of Damage as Extra Chaos Damage
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Ming slew Tranquillity
Took Chaos for his wife
And on Her immortal finger
He placed his Heart

The warriors of the Unblinking Eye moved

When the hand grips hard

forever cold.

the world will perish in ice.

she surpassed her master in pure malevolence.

Centuries of servitude, a day
of glory, an eternity of death.

The beasts we fear the most
are the ones who dwell in total darkness.

The Counts of Ogham share a
legacy of cunning and power.

"The time has passed for diplomacy!
If they will not respect House Azadi, 
then let them die gloriously... and loudly.
We are the masters of the Death Trades!"
- Ratha Azadi

ItemMetadata.name: The Whispering Ice
explicit_mods: +(5-7) to Level of all Cold Spell Skills
Inflict Elemental Exposure on Hit, lowering Total Elemental Resistances by (50-60)%
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"From what beast you derived, we can only fathom.
Aye, you of living ice, rotting gill, and untold nightmare!
We Brinerot return ye to the sea."
- Weylam Roth

ItemMetadata.name: Atziri's Rule
explicit_mods: +(3-5) to Level of all Corrupted Spell Skill Gems
Spells which cost Life Gain (80-120)% of Damage as Extra Physical Damage
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Bow before her... or suffer the most gruelling death imaginable.

uniques.Text: The Hammer of Faith Giant Maul
uniques.Name: The Hammer of Faith

ItemMetadata.name: The Hammer of Faith
explicit_mods: Every 10 seconds, gain a random non-damaging Shrine buff for 20 seconds
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The secret Order endured by publicly
praying however the Templars demanded.
One day, justice would fall upon them...

ItemMetadata.name: Trenchtimbre
explicit_mods: +(1-2) to Level of all Minion Skills
Increases and Reductions to Minion Attack Speed also affect you
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Ezomyte loyalty was not given to distant leaders.
It was earned by comrades in arms.

ItemMetadata.name: Quill Rain
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"The rain of a thousand quills that whittle
present into past, life into death."
- Rigwald of the Ezomytes

ItemMetadata.name: Marohi Erqi
explicit_mods: Heavy Stuns Enemies that are on Full Life
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"Drunken Erqi boasted to Tukohama; the God of War
challenged him to a clash of strength. Woe to the
Divine - he should have made it a test of skill!"

ItemMetadata.name: Duality
explicit_mods: Gain Finality for (0.5-0.5).5 seconds per Combo expended when using Skills
Gain (500-1000) Guard for 0.5 seconds per Combo expended when using Skills
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Dannig saw Seren in his mind's eye, a public ornament of
extravagance. Until she bore Cadigan a son and vanished.
Decadence covering brutality, like all Kalguuran customs.

ItemMetadata.name: Doomfletch
explicit_mods: Attacks with this Weapon gain (100-100)% of Physical damage as Extra damage of each Element
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"Toasted or frozen
Or twitching in the light
I'm not fussy
And neither is Death."
- Koralus Doomfletch

ItemMetadata.name: Voltaxic Rift
explicit_mods: (100-100)% of Lightning Damage Converted to Chaos Damage
Chaos Damage from Hits also Contributes to Shock Chance
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The eldritch storm descended upon us, and bruised lightning
rained down. Metal withered and flesh melted before its
arcane power. There was no escape, no shelter. Only despair.

ItemMetadata.name: Atziri's Contempt
explicit_mods: Spear Skills inflict a Bloodstone Lance on Hit, up to a maximum of 30 on each target
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"My people? I'm not doing this for them.
They belong to me. They want this for me.
Their sacrifice is a gift they give out of love
and adoration... I deserve it. I am their Queen."

ItemMetadata.name: Quecholli
implicit_mods: Causes Enemies to Explode on Critical kill, for (10-10)% of their Life as Physical Damage
explicit_mods: This Weapon's Critical Hit Chance is (100-100)%
Critical Hits do not deal extra Damage
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"The finest prosperity grows from the direst
carnage. Such is the nature of progress."
- Doryani of the Vaal

ItemMetadata.name: Enezun's Charge
explicit_mods: (30-50)% increased Critical Hit Chance for Spells
(25-25)% chance to not destroy Corpses when Consuming Corpses
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: He alone was welcome in the sacred spaces of the Titans.

ItemMetadata.name: Collapsing Horizon
explicit_mods: +(2-4) to Level of all Elemental Skills
Trigger skills refund half of Energy spent
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: The edges bend, the world flexes, the infinite spills into view.

ItemMetadata.name: Lioneye's Glare
explicit_mods: +2 metres to Dodge Roll distance if you haven't Dodge Rolled Recently
(-1--1) metre to Dodge Roll distance if you've Dodge Rolled Recently
Barrageable Attacks with this Bow Repeat +(2-2) times if no enemies are in your Presence
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"Kinslayer, you dishonour your own traditions to turn the tide of battle! 
Let us see which is stronger... Karui savagery or the might of the Empire!"
- General Marceus Lioneye

ItemMetadata.name: The Raven's Flock
explicit_mods: Minions have (10-20)% chance to inflict Gruelling Madness on Hit
(30-50)% increased Spirit Reservation Efficiency of Skills
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"Where the boy went, ravens gathered,
feasting on misery. His vile influence
spread, swift as the carnage they wrought."

ItemMetadata.name: Nebuloch
explicit_mods: Attacks consume an Endurance Charge to Critically Hit
Take (100-100) Chaos damage per second per Endurance Charge
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
They hoped that, trapped in its prison,
the creature would age and perish.
But time would not touch the fiend.

ItemMetadata.name: Cursecarver
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Lost in the Black Fen, Erian hoped that dawn would save him. He had no idea how far away the light truly was.

ItemMetadata.name: Frostbreath
explicit_mods: All Damage from Hits with this Weapon Contributes to Freeze Buildup
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
A merciful murderer swept through the streets of Sarn
Robbing breath from the weak and worthless.

ItemMetadata.name: Chainsting
explicit_mods: All Damage from Hits with this Weapon Contributes to Pin Buildup
(20-30)% increased Projectile Speed with this Weapon
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: The Sacred Hunt ends with mercy.

ItemMetadata.name: Tangletongue
explicit_mods: (10-10)% of Skill Mana Costs Converted to Life Costs
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"In the hands of Orbala, it made a god bleed."
- Wranga, tale-woman of the Wahida akhara

ItemMetadata.name: The Dark Defiler
explicit_mods: Gain (5-5)% of Damage as Chaos Damage per Undead Minion
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Rare is the Necromancer who leads
his undead armies from the front.

ItemMetadata.name: Lifesprig
explicit_mods: +(1-3) to Level of all Spell Skills
Leeches 1% of maximum Life when you Cast a Spell
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
From the smallest seeds
To the tallest redwoods,
Life endures in Wraeclast.

ItemMetadata.name: Widowhail
explicit_mods: (150-250)% increased bonuses gained from Equipped Quiver
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"I loosed a volley of arrows into the heart of the man
who slew my beloved. There was no satisfaction, no
healing, no revenge. There was only... emptiness."

ItemMetadata.name: Rampart Raptor
explicit_mods:
Bolts fired by Crossbow Attacks have (100-100)% chance to not
expend Ammunition if you've Reloaded Recently
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"His approach to the gate was met with sounding trumpets
and an unfurling of banners. He never saw it coming."
- anonymous Brotherhood of Silence report

ItemMetadata.name: Double Vision
explicit_mods:
When you reload, triggers Gemini Surge to alternately
gain (2-6) Cold Surges or 5 Fire Surges
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
For those without a home in the Vastiri, the
hot day is harsh, but the chill night is far worse.

ItemMetadata.name: The Last Lament
explicit_mods: Leeches (5-10).81% of Physical Damage as Life
(10-20)% chance to load a bolt into all Crossbow skills on Kill
Sacrifice (300-300) Life to not consume the last bolt when firing
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"And here we shall remain... 
trapped in our symphony of eternal anguish.
Artist and Composer, their fates entwined for all of time."
- Adamantia Brektov, the Composer

uniques.Text: Pillar of the Caged God Long Quarterstaff
uniques.Name: Pillar of the Caged God

ItemMetadata.name: Pillar of the Caged God
implicit_mods: (16-16)% increased Melee Strike Range with this weapon
explicit_mods: 1% increased Area of Effect for Attacks per 10 Intelligence
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Forged to rule the waves and tide
Destined to serve the monkey's paw
Strong as a tower of iron
Deft as the needle doubt

ItemMetadata.name: The Sentry
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The night Draven attacked,
Erian was asleep at his post.

ItemMetadata.name: Matsya
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: In our tales, and in our hearts, the rivers still flow.

ItemMetadata.name: Nazir's Judgement
explicit_mods: (35-50)% increased Melee Damage against Heavy Stunned enemies
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The first witch hunter knew one critical tactic:
never let your enemy have a clear moment.

ItemMetadata.name: Earthbound
explicit_mods: Trigger Spark Skill on killing a Shocked Enemy
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: An ancient Azmeri staff, overgrown by roots...

ItemMetadata.name: The Empty Roar
explicit_mods: Leeches (10-10)% of Physical Damage as Life
(10-20)% chance to cause Bleeding on Hit
All Attacks count as Empowered Attacks
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Secrecy and silence are powers all their own.

ItemMetadata.name: Shyaba
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Be not deceived by the treachery of men.

ItemMetadata.name: Chober Chaber
explicit_mods: Increases and Reductions to Minion Damage also affect you
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: The faithful may continue to serve, even after death.

ItemMetadata.name: Olrovasara
explicit_mods:
On Hitting an enemy, gains maximum added Lightning damage equal to
the enemy's Power for (500-500) seconds, up to a total of 500
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"True heroes grow stronger in the face of adversity."
- Fourth Tenet of the Knights of the Sun

ItemMetadata.name: Sadist's Mercy
explicit_mods: Hits with this Weapon inflict (2-5) Gruelling Madness
Enemies in your Presence have additional Power equal to their Gruelling Madness
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"You mortals are insidious. You repress your
evil, or deny it exists. Liars! When I open
your heads, that violence floods out."
- The Raven Trickster

ItemMetadata.name: Tyranny's Grip
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The might of the Eternal Empire was formidable,
but rebels of every culture stood together as one.

ItemMetadata.name: Daevata's Wind
implicit_mods: (25-35)% increased Projectile Speed with this Weapon
explicit_mods: (30-60)% increased Melee Damage if you've dealt a Projectile Attack Hit in the past eight seconds
(30-60)% increased Projectile Damage if you've dealt a Melee Hit in the past eight seconds
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"You killed their Golden Sekhema. The Maraketh will think of nothing
but vengeance now." - Dimos, Advisor to General Titucius

ItemMetadata.name: Font of Power
explicit_mods:
When a Party Member in your Presence Casts a Spell, you
Sacrifice (20-20)% of Mana and they Leech that Mana
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Tale-women may not fight directly,
for they have a much higher purpose.

ItemMetadata.name: Sanguine Diviner
explicit_mods: (25-25)% chance to inflict Bleeding on Hit
(25-25)% of Spell Mana Cost Converted to Life Cost
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: One way or another, it will find what it seeks.

ItemMetadata.name: Death's Harp
implicit_mods: +(50-50)% Surpassing chance to fire an additional Arrow
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The mournful music of the strings,
The creaking arch, the arrow sings.
A choking cry, a rattled breath,
The Reaper's Song, the Harp of Death.

ItemMetadata.name: Slivertongue
explicit_mods: Leeches (5-8).07% of Physical Damage as Life
Leeches (4-7).04% of Physical Damage as Mana
Arrows Pierce all targets after Forking
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: A hundred blind heads, each seeking the taste of prey on the air.

ItemMetadata.name: Mist Whisper
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Sibilant promises surrounded them in the night.
All the travelers had to give him was their devotion...

ItemMetadata.name: Taryn's Shiver
explicit_mods: Enemies Frozen by you take (100-100)% increased Damage
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Shed by the winged beast of night,
A scaly frost-encrusted thorn.
All who feel its wintry light
Shiver in pain at the frozen dawn.

uniques.Text: The Burden of Shadows Chiming Staff
uniques.Name: The Burden of Shadows

ItemMetadata.name: The Burden of Shadows
explicit_mods: Skill Mana Costs Converted to Life Costs
Skills gain 1% of Damage as Chaos Damage per 3 Life Cost
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Nothingness is loathe to relinquish its grip.
Every moment is a struggle to exist.

ItemMetadata.name: Sire of Shards
explicit_mods:
Spells fire (4-4) additional Projectiles
Spells fire Projectiles in a circle
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: That which was broken may yet break.

ItemMetadata.name: Hrimnor's Hymn
explicit_mods: Slam Skills you use yourself cause an additional Aftershock
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"The crack of bone, the spray of blood.
Is there sweeter music?"
- Hrimnor of the Ezomytes.

ItemMetadata.name: Trephina
explicit_mods: Always deals Critical Hits against Heavy Stunned Enemies
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: The art of surgery advances one mistake at a time.

ItemMetadata.name: Brain Rattler
explicit_mods: All damage with this Weapon causes Electrocution buildup
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: The mind may have no limits, but the skull sure does.

ItemMetadata.name: Brynhand's Mark
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: The mark of the smith was widely known.

ItemMetadata.name: Sculpted Suffering
explicit_mods: Breaks Armour equal to (40-40)% of damage from Hits with this weapon
Fully Armour Broken enemies you kill with Hits Shatter
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The Abyssals were created, not born,
and every moment in the light was agony.

ItemMetadata.name: Seeing Stars
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Within lies a window.

ItemMetadata.name: Splinter of Lorrata
explicit_mods: (20-20)% increased Melee Strike Range with this weapon
Any number of Poisons from this Weapon can affect a target at the same time
Always Poison on Hit with this weapon
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: The Baleful Gem's corruption lingers still...

ItemMetadata.name: The Wicked Quill
explicit_mods: Spells have a (25-25)% chance to inflict Withered for 4 seconds on Hit
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
With a flick of the finger, their fates are written,
the pages torn to a million pieces.

ItemMetadata.name: Ironbound
implicit_mods: (25-35)% chance to Chain an additional time
explicit_mods: (3-5)% increased Block chance per 100 total Item Armour on Equipped Armour Items
Hits with this weapon have (4-5) to 4 Added Physical Damage per 1% Block Chance
Arrows Return if they have Pierced a target which had Fully Broken Armour
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Each crest was a Thane's word, bolted to Ivor's bow.
They would join the Count's side, or die by his hands.

ItemMetadata.name: Splinterheart
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The forests of the Vastiri held many secrets
mystical and dark. Men learned not to wander,
lest they return with a strange new purpose.

ItemMetadata.name: The Blood Thorn
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: Touch not the thorn, for only blood and pain await.

ItemMetadata.name: Dusk Vigil
explicit_mods: Gain (30-50)% of Damage as Extra Fire Damage
Trigger Ember Fusillade Skill on casting a Spell
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: The candlemass tradition was born in a time of darkness and fear.

ItemMetadata.name: The Searing Touch
explicit_mods: Ignites you inflict spread to other Enemies that stay within 1.5 metres for 1 second
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Burn to cinders, scar and maim,
Rule a world, bathed in flame.

ItemMetadata.name: Hoghunt
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
There was a very clear and delicious
reason why the Ezomytes chose to
stop their flight and settle in Phaaryl.

ItemMetadata.name: Tidebreaker
explicit_mods: +(2-3) to Level of all Melee Skills
All Damage from Hits with this Weapon Contributes to Chill Magnitude
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The sea strikes the rock relentlessly.
Whether in one day or in ten thousand years,
eventually the rock will crumble,
and the Brine King's domain will grow.

ItemMetadata.name: Fairgraves' Curse
explicit_mods: Attack Hits inflict Spectral Fire for (8-8) seconds
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
The power of the Allflame rends
souls just as easily as flesh.

ItemMetadata.name: The Unborn Lich
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
In ghastly pits beneath the world,
Kulemak grows countless new bodies,
each more powerful than the last.
Not all of his abominations survive.

ItemMetadata.name: Amor Mandragora
explicit_mods: Enemies in your Presence are Hindered
Gain (20-20) Druidic Prowess for every 20 total Rage spent
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
A sensitive few among the first settlers of Ezomyr
followed the wisps by canoe. On a misty forested
island, Cirel of Tarth stood waiting to greet them.

uniques.Text: Surge of the Tide Lumbering Talisman
uniques.Name: Surge of the Tide

ItemMetadata.name: Surge of the Tide
explicit_mods:
Every second Slam Skill you use while Shapeshifted is Ancestrally Boosted
Every second Strike Skill you use while Shapeshifted is Ancestrally Boosted
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
"A traditional hatungo does not carry an axe,
it is true. But as Narumoa showed us, there
are many ways to crush one's enemy..."

ItemMetadata.name: Spiteful Floret
explicit_mods: (20-30)% chance to cause Bleeding on Hit

ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
If you see the blushing tree of the northern woods,
remember: "Blossoms of red, the tree's been fed.
Blossoms of white, prepare for a fight."

ItemMetadata.name: Hysseg's Claw
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
In a time of great need, surrounded by Abyssals,
the Wayward Druid came to the Sun Clan's aid.
It is a debt they have never forgotten.

ItemMetadata.name: The Flesh Poppet

you Shapeshift to an Animal form
Modifiers gained this way are lost after (30-30) seconds or when you next Shapeshift
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
Long ago, the witches of the Azak Tribe learned
how to tap into the flow of Vivid lifeforce to
'cooperate' with their enemies... forcefully.

ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
A common soldier from a common family kept hammering into the night
after each grueling march, his eyes afire with starlight and determination.
Few suspected that he would one day become the greatest among them.

ItemMetadata.name: The Last Flame
explicit_mods: Cannot be used with Trials below level (80-80)
This item is destroyed when applied to a Trial
ItemMetadata.flavor_text: In the coldest depths of the Winter of the World, overrun by darkness and fighting to the last, life itself clung to existence by the barest remaining thread.

ItemMetadata.name: The Desperate Alliance

Zarokh, the Temporal takes (-75--75)% less Damage
This item is destroyed when applied to a Trial
ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
By fire and ice, perhaps the end of the world.
They did not fall on their knees and lament.
ItemMetadata.description: Place this item on the Relic Altar at the start of the Trial of the Sekhemas

ItemMetadata.flavor_text:
All rejoiced when Solerai and Lundara shattered the grey sky,
